programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: In 1933, a mysterious ghost train arrives in Changsha, prompting military commander Zhang Qishan to investigate a hidden mine containing ancient secrets targeted by Japanese forces. Joining forces with opera singer Er Yue Hong and hotel heiress Yin Xinyue, Qishan and the city's powerful "Mystic Nine" families must navigate deadly underground traps to solve a century-old mystery and protect their nation from invasion.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: the brewery, Kai-shan's younger brothers Kai-shek (Timothy Cheng), Kai-tsun (Gary Chan) and Kai-kong (Tsui Wing) want to divide the family fortune. And even outsider General Ko Shiu-wing (Andrew Yuen) is plotting to get his hands on a piece of the pie. With a 100-year history, Man Koon Brewery's future is in doubt as it gets into such a precarious situation.

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: While being instructed to investigate some transnational crime, OCTB officers Hui Chun-sum (Ruco Chan) and Shum Wai-lik (Ben Wong) find out Ngai Chi-lok (Cheung Wing Hong), who was the culprit behind the Tiger Cull case, sent some secret message to the dark web before he was apprehended. He also made a transfer of a substantial amount in cryptocurrency. And soon some mysterious person plots to launch a terrorist attack. Although Chun-sum and Wai-lik solve the case with the help of the talented Prof Tong Kwun-fung (Alex Fong), but they are shocked to realize there is some more evil conspiracy hidden behind Chi-lok! While they just have to foil Chi-lok's scheme, they also have to deal with strange cases such as dragon head rod crisis, white bones in empty space and hardened criminal jailbreak. And are they able to clear away obstacles? While crisis escalates in the workplace, there are also challenging love issues. Chun-sum hopes to be reunited with his ex-girlfriend Ma Wing-sze (Lam Ha Mei). However, the couple's relationship is kind of iffy as they have deal with so many problems.

programme.title: Handmaidens United
programme.desc: Yuet-ying (Jacqueline Wong) is a maid in the Vice Minister of War Kau Residence. She is also the leader of six groups of maids, who have formed an intelligence sharing alliance to make money. Yuet-gau (Roxanne Tong) has sold herself and become a maid as she is raising money for her beloved Fu Yau-wai (Brian Tse) to go to the capital to take the imperial exam. Yuet-ying and Yuet-gau are taking care of Madam Koon Chi-pui (Florence Kwok) and Madam Sheungkoon Wan-ying (Angie Cheong) respectively. The duo keep trying to outwit each other for the sake of their bosses. Kau Kei-tsun (Tony Hung), aka Young Master, and Yuet-ying become lovers. Regrettably, Kei-tsun's father Kau Ching (Timothy Cheng) makes Kei-tsun's life difficult. Kau Ching is demoted as he has committed some offense. Kei-tsun diligently prepares to tackle the imperial exam as he wants to restore family honor. Fok Yin-jing (Lisa Lau), the daughter of Minister of War Fok Bun (Poon Chi Man), also fancies Yau-wai and repeatedly seduces him. Yuet-ying and Yuet-gau are determined to jeopardize their lovers' study efforts as they are afraid of being ditched if their guys pass the imperial exam with flying colors. While both couples are about to break up, they are abruptly drawn into a coup conspiracy.

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: Police officer, SIT TAN-YAN (Johnson Lee), is a no ordinary man because he possesses authentic knowledge and skills in geomancy that he learned from his grandfather, and often manages to solve mysterious cases at critical moments. On top of that, having his best friend LEUNG SING-KAU (Oscar Leung), who has connections on both sides of the law, be his informant, his style of work amazes his superior CHE KWAI-FEI (Joey Meng) very much. As a criminal psychologist, KWAI-FEI makes a decision solely based on rational factors. Though the two seem to be poles apart, they have developed a close rapport with each other. Apart from her job, KWAI-FEI, being the matriarch of her family, cares for nothing but the future of her younger sister CHE KWAI-MEI (Harriet Yeung) and brother CHE KWAI-KWAN (Fred Cheng). When KWAI-MEI gets caught up in a love triangle involving SING-KAU and KWAI-FEI's subordinate TIT LEUNG-CHI (Rebecca Zhu), KWAI-FEI becomes out of control, fortunately, she gets help from TAN-YAN. Meanwhile, there have been consecutive reports of kidnapped persons in town, and the abduction method evokes TAN-YAN's memories of the past that he has hidden for years. Without hesitation, KWAI-FEI risks her own life to investigate the cases, whereas TAN-YAN predicts that something is going to happen......

programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao
programme.desc: This historical drama follows the turbulent lives of the Ye brothers, Sun Zhongyi and Huangfu Zaiqing, alongside the three daughters of Sun Jingchun—a renowned opera performer from Ziyang Street. Spanning from the War of Resistance through decades of separation across the Taiwan Strait to the modern era, the story weaves together romance, family feuds, intelligence warfare, and changing times. As the characters navigate love, heartbreak, and unexpected twists of fate, they remain tied to their shared devotion to their country and family.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victim's mother and the murderer's mother as they uncover their sons' hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back?

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his father's will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap…

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3
programme.desc: Monkey King, Pigsy and Sandy escort Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and accidentally head into the mysterious Female Kingdom. The Queen falls in love with Monk Tang at first sight, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be executed. As the four attract the appearance of River Spirit, the Female Kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the family's empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his father's followers fighting for control.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his father's heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse “Red Hare” to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, “Red Hare” may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Linda Hashim, Zul Huzaimy, Joe Aziz dan Nadia Rosli.

programme.title: TRENDSETTER
programme.desc: Trendsetter kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal! Episod kali ini menampilkan Adrihana Rashid (Usya Kedai), Nicholas Chin (Gaya & Kerjaya), serta Muhammad Mirzan yang membedah perincian beg mewah LV Capucines.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Maisarah kecewa lalu memaksa hatinya menerima cinta Irfan. Selepas tiga tahun, Maisarah akhirnya bersedia untuk berkahwin dengan Irfan kerana keikhlasan lelaki itu. Namun, kebahagiaan mereka dikejutkan dengan berita buruk.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Datin Jasmin meminta maaf atas segala yang dilakukan. Syarfan meragui kebaikan ibunya namun menerima semula Datin Jasmin di rumah. Keadaan Razali makin teruk. Nazarin membantu Alia menjaga Razali. Hana meletakkan racun di dalam minuman Antasya bagi membunuh anak di dalam kandungan Antasya. Hana mahu Syarfan menjadi miliknya. Datin Jasmin merancang membunuh Razali dan orang yang menghalangnya .

programme.title: Cek Ombak
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kika dan Igo, sepasang kekasih yang bertemu melalui aplikasi kencan, namun menghadapi komplikasi rumit ketika orang tua mereka menikah. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh ikatan persaudaraan tiri dan penolakan orang tua.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Villa yang tenang itu sinarkan dengan kebahagiaan. Iskandar tidak menyangka Tengku Maria akan membawa Aisyah bertemu dengannya di Villa itu. Iskandar merasakan sesuatu yang aneh dalam hatinya namun dia tidak mampu melawan rasa kecewanya apabila Aisyah tidak mengingatinya. Di Villa itu, Aisyah berusaha untuk memujuk hati Iskandar. Segalanya telah dilakukan oleh Aisyah demi memohon maaf daripada seorang lelaki berstatus suami kepadanya. Aisyah sedar akan syurganya di bawah telapak kaki suami dan dia harus melutut memohon maaf daripada Iskandar meskipun ingtannya masih lemah. Tengku Maria mula tersenyum melihat adegan romantic mereka. Harapan dalam sebuah hubungan yang rumit itu dilihat semakin pulih dan cerah oleh Tengku Maria, namun dia tidak menduga, Iskandar mahu melepaskan Aisyah dan mahu Aisyah bersatu dengan Haziq. Dia menegaskan kepada Tengku Maria bahawa Hazqi menaruh cinta terhadap Aisyah sejak pertama kali mereka berjumpa. Tengku Mummy menegah apa yang dikatakan oleh Iskandar dan amat berharap Iskandar dapat menarik balik semula kata-katanya dan terus membina mahligai dia dan Aisyah. Tengku Maria sengaja meninggalkan Aisyah di Villa itu dan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur supaya mereka mempunyai ruang untuk memperbaiki hubungan seterusnya Iskandar dapat berfikir semula dan tidak melepaskan Aisyah.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. Walau bagaimanapun, mereka gembira meluahkan perihal jodoh masing-masing di e-mel sebagai "Cik Kak" dan "En. Beat". Rahsia itu hanya terbongkar pada hari pernikahan, mengejutkan kedua-duanya selepas mereka sah bergelar suami isteri.

programme.title: Satu, Dua…Dia?
programme.desc: Isa mengambil tindakan undang-undang terhadap Mia; Mia merasa tersepit dan terpaksa berdepan akibatnya.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel kecewa selepas Sara meninggalkannya dan gagal menghubunginya. Di kampung, Sara semakin rapat dengan Irfan yang sering menemani Tokma. Damia pula mengetahui Azmi curang lalu mendekati Dato Muiz. Airel cemburu melihat Sara bersama Irfan, manakala Maisarah tergamam apabila Irfan melamarnya.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya tak sempat mengkhabarkan berita gembira kepada Syarhan apabila tiba-tiba mengalami pendarahan. Syarfan mengamuk dan menuduh Antasya cuba menggugurkan kandungan kerana benci dengan hubungan mereka apabila mendapat tahu kandungan Antasya gugur disebabkan racun. Hubungan mereka kian dingin. Razali hilang dan disyaki diculik oleh Datin Jasmin.

programme.title: Parole Examiner Lee EP4
programme.desc: Han-shin menyiasat kes banduan yang dipaksa menjadi pengangkut dadah dari dalam penjara. Pergerakannya mula diperhatikan oleh Ji Myeong-seob, pewaris Ojung Group. Tekanan terhadap Han-shin semakin meningkat.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP15
programme.desc: Kerja vigilante McCall merumitkan lagi kehidupan peribadinya apabila dia terpaksa meminta bantuan bekas suaminya, Dr. Miles Fulton, untuk membantu mangsa tembakan, salah seorang daripada dua wanita yang diburu pencuri selepas mereka menyaksikan rompakan.

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Filem ini diilhamkan oleh legenda urban terkenal Malaysia mengenai sebuah Volkswagen berwarna kuning yang misteri yang dilihat di Lebuhraya Karak. Mengikut legenda, apabila anda melihat kereta tersebut di lebuhraya, jangan sesekali memotongnya kerana kereta itu akan terus muncul di hadapan anda, dan yang lebih menakutkan, tiada pemandu yang dilihat mengemudi kereta tersebut.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 1
programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza; mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Mummy Reborn
programme.desc: Apabila sekumpulan remaja dalam kemusnahan kewangan memutuskan untuk merompak kedai antik tempatan, mereka menemui sebuah kubur kayu lama yang mengandungi mayat Mumia dan azimat purba. Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pencuri kita mesti menyelamatkan hari ini dan mengembalikan Mumia ke kuburnya sebelum terlambat untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP6
programme.desc: Peristiwa ganjil menimbulkan persoalan, adakah ini sekadar histeria atau sesuatu yang benar-benar gelap?

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP4
programme.desc: Mengisahkan lima sahabat yang terlepas tren selepas terlalu lama berbincang di sebuah kafe berhampiran stesen. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Rajawali
programme.desc: “Rajawali” mengisahkan penggodam yang diupah Komang untuk memecah sistem komputer ciptaan Arwin, namun program itu merupakan ritual ilmu hitam digital. Arwin dirasuk oleh program tersebut, manakala Komang terjerumus ke kegelapan.

programme.title: Black S2 EP8
programme.desc: Black dan Sofia keluar janji temu seharian. Tapi kebahagiaan hilang apabila 007 dan 416 membawa berita buruk buat Black - orang atasan tidak gembira dengan kurangnya kemajuan yang dibuat oleh Black. Borhan telah membuat penemuan yang mengerikan dan dia menyedari yang dia akhirnya telah menemui bukti muktamad. Semuanya tertuju ke arah seseorang yang dia syak selama ini, tapi dia membuat satu lagi penemuan yang sangat mengejutkan.

programme.title: Raya Emas: Salako Sacred Treasure
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Sarawak, sebuah legenda kuno tentang "Raya Emas" telah diwarisi turun-temurun. Tapi apabila mata-mata tamak mula mengarah kepadanya, satu perjalanan yang menguji iman dan keberanian bakal terungkai.

programme.title: Beheading
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga menjadi sasaran kemurkaan suatu entiti, memaksa mereka mempersembahkan korban kuno dengan mengahwinkan anak perempuan mereka dengan patung semangat leluhur yang tidak berkepala.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP16
programme.desc: Apabila Aunty Vi merupakan satu-satunya juri dalam perbicaraan pembunuhan yang percaya bahawa defendan tidak bersalah, McCall secara rahsia menyiasat kes itu untuk mencari bukti bahawa naluri Vi adalah betul.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Daus menghalau Ben keluar dan memarahi Mia. Daus bersumpah yang dia tidak akan menjatuhkan talak pada Mia dan membiarkan Mia menganiaya lelaki lain seperti dia. Pergaduhan terjadi lagi dan Daus bertindak kasar lagi terhadap Mia. Lyssa cuba menahan Daus tetapi kakinya tiba2 lemah dan dia jatuh. Lyssa dikejarkan ke hospital. Berita kehamilan Lyssa tidak dapat mengimbangi kemarahan Daus terhadap kecurangan Mia. Lyssa sedih kerana tidak diberi perhatian yang sewajarnya dari Daus. Mia yang banyak menghabiskan masa membantu dan menguruskan Lyssa.

programme.title: Menuai Takdir
programme.desc: Erina yang tamak kemewahan hidup senang selepas berkahwin dengan Amir, namun segalanya berubah apabila mereka jatuh miskin dan dia mula merendahkan suaminya. Terpedaya dengan lelaki kaya, Erina hampir melarikan diri, tetapi tersedar apabila mengetahui lelaki itu sebenarnya suami jahat yang mendera isterinya. Akhirnya, Erina insaf dan kembali kepada Amir serta ibunya, menyedari kebahagiaan sebenar bukan pada harta tetapi pada kasih sayang.

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Tajid membawa topik "Jiwa & Tazkiyah " dengan panel Ustaz Panel Ustaz Rahimi. Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Cerita Bintang
programme.desc: Cerita Bintang menampilkan artis-artis popular yang memberi peluang kepada peminat untuk lebih mengenali lebih rapat artis pujaan mereka. Episod kali ini Anis akan membawa penonton untuk menemu bual dengan Lan Solo

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Deko Ibadah
programme.desc: Team Deko Ibadah kali ini berada di Surau Saidina Ali Karramallah Wajhah. Deko Ibadah berkongsi inspirasi menghias dan menyusun ruang ibadah yang selesa, praktikal serta menenangkan. Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah "Sakit” Bersama Ustaz Safwan Idris yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Jom Jalan
programme.desc: Bersama Jom Jalan kali ini Awi Rafael akan membawa para penonton ke Pulau Kapas. Jom Jalan musim kali ini membawa Selebriti tanah air ke pulau-pulau menarik yang ada di Malaysia. Pada setiap pelbagai destinasi menarik akan dipaparkan meliputi lokasi aktivi ketika percutian, makanan dan tempat-tempat menarik yang sesuai dikunjungi.

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Tajid membawa topik "Jiwa & Tazkiyah " dengan panel Ustaz Panel Ustaz Rahimi. Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Sembang Alam Ghaib
programme.desc: Episod kali ini membawakn topik "Gangguan tidur". Program ini mengupas pelbagai kisah seram berkaitan alam ghaib, dengan menampilkan cerita yang diadaptasi daripada pengalaman benar yang pernah dilalui sendiri oleh Dato' Ustaz Kazim Elias. Setiap episod turut menyelitkan pengajaran dan panduan dari perspektif Islam mengenai perkara-perkara ghaib.

programme.title: Kisah Dalam Al Quran
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini ustaz akan membawakan kisah mengenai "Kisah Misteri Besi Dalam Al-Quran”. Kisah yang dipaparkan oleh al-Quran adalah sebahagian daripada tanda-tanda mukjizat kerana ia menceritakan mengenai umat terdahulu yang sebahagian besar tidak diketahui.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Ceritaku
programme.desc: Ceritaku adalah sebuah program realiti mengisahkan seorang wartawan bebas bernama Siti Aishah yang prihatin dengan keadaan sekeliling dan ingin membantu insan-insan yang tidak berkemampuan. Siti Aishah yang peka dengan kesusahan mereka yang tidak bernasib baik ini akan mencari VIP dan usahawan untuk membantu meringankan beban insan-insan yang tidak berkemampuan ini.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “Berjaya Dengan Solat”. Bersama Ustaz Hariri yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Cerita Bintang
programme.desc: Cerita Bintang menampilkan artis-artis popular yang memberi peluang kepada peminat untuk lebih mengenali lebih rapat artis pujaan mereka. Episod kali ini Anis akan membawa penonton untuk menemu bual dengan Azharina.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Mustaza yang dikejarkan di hospital memerlukan duit untuk membayar bil perubatan. Mereka tidak ada duit untuk bayar kerana ketiadaan Hamidah. Hazelin pula diberi mandat untuk menjaga Syarikat ibunya semasa ketiadaan ibunya.

programme.title: Doa
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membincangkan doa mengenai “Doa Merawat Pesakit”. Doa akan membicarakan mengenai doa-doa yang dapat kita gunakan dalam seharian kita bukan sahaja doa selepas solat tetapi solat yang boleh kita amalkan agar terselamat di dunia dan akhirat.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “Jaga Lisan, Jaga Hati”. Bersama Ustaz Rahimi yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.desc: Aura bintang membawakan kisah selebriti khususnya yang mejurus kepada perubahan positif yang wujud setelah mereka berhijrah. Rancangan ini merangkumi 4 segmen iaitu hijrah, addin, islam dan kifayah. Episod kali ini Dayah Bakar akan membawa penonton menemu bual dengan Iwan Shahman.

programme.title: Tok Guru

programme.title: Jom Tanya & Bertarannum
programme.desc: Dalam episod ini topik yang akan dibincangkan mengenai permasalahan tentang orang yang selalu menipu & ustaz memberikan satu doa supaya tidak menjadi pendusta dalam masyarakat. serta ustaz akan mengajar para pelajar mengaji surah at-tin dalam tarannum hijaz.

programme.title: Kembara Muslim
programme.desc: Kembara Muslim musim ke 2 ini akan membawa para penonton melawat tempat-tempat menarik di Malaysia dan seni bina masjid yang terdapat di negara kita. Dalam episod ini Bersama Ustaz Safwan yang akan mengembara ke negeri Melaka.

programme.title: Game Over Romeo
programme.desc: Hany luah perasaan pada Azam dan tanya bila Azam hendak bertindak pada Firdaus? Baginya, Tiya dan Firdaus tidak tahu mengenang budi. Sudahlah semua harta pusaka direbutnya. Sebab itu, Hany tetap nak tengok Firdaus dan Tiya tak aman. Hany juga sakit hati bila tengok Black layan baik Tiya. Dengan Ammar lagi mengejarnya sedangkan Hany asyik kecewa cinta saja. Baginya kalau dia tidak gembira, Tiya juga tidak boleh gembira.

programme.title: Setiaku Di Sini
programme.desc: Aleesa menemui Rayyan dan memulangkan semula henfon itu kepada Rayyan. Dia tidak mahu menerima pemberian Rayyan. Rayyan memberitahu Aleesa yang dia telah meminta kebenaran dari bapa Aleesa untuk membawa Aleesa keluar. Pada mulanya Aleesa tidak percaya tetapi Rayyan menunjukkan bukti mesejnya dengan bapa Aleesa. Rayyan mengakui dia menyintai Aleesa. Aleesa terharu kerana tidak menyangka lelaki yang dia benci dan lelaki yang dia hina dengan kata-kata kesat rupanya mencintai dia.

programme.title: Aku Ada Wali
programme.desc: Melanjutkan pelajaran universiti di luar negara membuatkan Syumaila berazam untuk menunaikan amanah ibu bapanya untuk mendapatkan ilmu. Naim pula cuba berusaha untuk mendapatkan cinta Syumailan namun azam Syumaila hanya untuk mendapatkan ilmu kerana Allah dan membantu ibunya lagi menguatkan azamnya untuk mengelak cinta Naim.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Mia mengangkat Lyssa dan membawanya ke hospital. Sepanjang Lyssa di hospital, Mia menjaga Lyssa dengan baik. Mujurlah kandungan Lyssa selamat dan dia diminta untuk berehat. Sewaktu di hospital juga, Mia meminta Ben menjauhkan diri darinya kerana dia tidak mahu Lyssa menjadi mangsa sekiranya berlaku pergaduhan antara dia dan Daus. Sekembalinya ke rumah, Mia terus menjaga Lyssa yang masih bercuti dari kerja. Mia gembira menyediakan kelengkapan untuk baby yang bakal lahir. Daus mula cemruru melihat kemesraan antara Mia dan Lyssa.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: In 1933, a mysterious ghost train arrives in Changsha, prompting military commander Zhang Qishan to investigate a hidden mine containing ancient secrets targeted by Japanese forces. Joining forces with opera singer Er Yue Hong and hotel heiress Yin Xinyue, Qishan and the city's powerful "Mystic Nine" families must navigate deadly underground traps to solve a century-old mystery and protect their nation from invasion.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: Police officer, SIT TAN-YAN (Johnson Lee), is a no ordinary man because he possesses authentic knowledge and skills in geomancy that he learned from his grandfather, and often manages to solve mysterious cases at critical moments. On top of that, having his best friend LEUNG SING-KAU (Oscar Leung), who has connections on both sides of the law, be his informant, his style of work amazes his superior CHE KWAI-FEI (Joey Meng) very much. As a criminal psychologist, KWAI-FEI makes a decision solely based on rational factors. Though the two seem to be poles apart, they have developed a close rapport with each other. Apart from her job, KWAI-FEI, being the matriarch of her family, cares for nothing but the future of her younger sister CHE KWAI-MEI (Harriet Yeung) and brother CHE KWAI-KWAN (Fred Cheng). When KWAI-MEI gets caught up in a love triangle involving SING-KAU and KWAI-FEI's subordinate TIT LEUNG-CHI (Rebecca Zhu), KWAI-FEI becomes out of control, fortunately, she gets help from TAN-YAN. Meanwhile, there have been consecutive reports of kidnapped persons in town, and the abduction method evokes TAN-YAN's memories of the past that he has hidden for years. Without hesitation, KWAI-FEI risks her own life to investigate the cases, whereas TAN-YAN predicts that something is going to happen......

programme.title: Handmaidens United
programme.desc: Yuet-ying (Jacqueline Wong) is a maid in the Vice Minister of War Kau Residence. She is also the leader of six groups of maids, who have formed an intelligence sharing alliance to make money. Yuet-gau (Roxanne Tong) has sold herself and become a maid as she is raising money for her beloved Fu Yau-wai (Brian Tse) to go to the capital to take the imperial exam. Yuet-ying and Yuet-gau are taking care of Madam Koon Chi-pui (Florence Kwok) and Madam Sheungkoon Wan-ying (Angie Cheong) respectively. The duo keep trying to outwit each other for the sake of their bosses. Kau Kei-tsun (Tony Hung), aka Young Master, and Yuet-ying become lovers. Regrettably, Kei-tsun's father Kau Ching (Timothy Cheng) makes Kei-tsun's life difficult. Kau Ching is demoted as he has committed some offense. Kei-tsun diligently prepares to tackle the imperial exam as he wants to restore family honor. Fok Yin-jing (Lisa Lau), the daughter of Minister of War Fok Bun (Poon Chi Man), also fancies Yau-wai and repeatedly seduces him. Yuet-ying and Yuet-gau are determined to jeopardize their lovers' study efforts as they are afraid of being ditched if their guys pass the imperial exam with flying colors. While both couples are about to break up, they are abruptly drawn into a coup conspiracy.

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN (Ma Steven), who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Tau's Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET (Yeung Yi), daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN (Wong Ho Yin), son of salt merchant WU KIN (Kwok Fung). HIN takes her home. One day, SUET is horrified to see the dead bodies of her parent being hung on the wall of the city tower, and that the official standing on the top of the tower telling the public not to sell smuggled salt is none other than the man she misses day and night. She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

She is heartbroken, and her love for YUEN turns into hatred that moment on… HIN finds a job for SUET at the salt company his family runs to help her get over her unhappiness. To repay him, she devotes herself entirely to the job. As time goes by, HIN starts to fall in love with her. However his critical illness making him hesitates to express his love for her. SUET's real identity comes to light when her younger uncle reappears out of the blue. HIN, for fear that his family will report SUET, proposes to her…

programme.title: Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: Police officer, SIT TAN-YAN (Johnson Lee), is a no ordinary man because he possesses authentic knowledge and skills in geomancy that he learned from his grandfather, and often manages to solve mysterious cases at critical moments. On top of that, having his best friend LEUNG SING-KAU (Oscar Leung), who has connections on both sides of the law, be his informant, his style of work amazes his superior CHE KWAI-FEI (Joey Meng) very much. As a criminal psychologist, KWAI-FEI makes a decision solely based on rational factors. Though the two seem to be poles apart, they have developed a close rapport with each other. Apart from her job, KWAI-FEI, being the matriarch of her family, cares for nothing but the future of her younger sister CHE KWAI-MEI (Harriet Yeung) and brother CHE KWAI-KWAN (Fred Cheng). When KWAI-MEI gets caught up in a love triangle involving SING-KAU and KWAI-FEI's subordinate TIT LEUNG-CHI (Rebecca Zhu), KWAI-FEI becomes out of control, fortunately, she gets help from TAN-YAN. Meanwhile, there have been consecutive reports of kidnapped persons in town, and the abduction method evokes TAN-YAN's memories of the past that he has hidden for years. Without hesitation, KWAI-FEI risks her own life to investigate the cases, whereas TAN-YAN predicts that something is going to happen......

programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao
programme.desc: This historical drama follows the turbulent lives of the Ye brothers, Sun Zhongyi and Huangfu Zaiqing, alongside the three daughters of Sun Jingchun—a renowned opera performer from Ziyang Street. Spanning from the War of Resistance through decades of separation across the Taiwan Strait to the modern era, the story weaves together romance, family feuds, intelligence warfare, and changing times. As the characters navigate love, heartbreak, and unexpected twists of fate, they remain tied to their shared devotion to their country and family.
